name: busybox
notes: POSIX sh (ash) and utility set for /bin (decision 0004). Applets whose syscalls the Linux personality does not route yet stay on okcrt; busybox.config lists them. clang_cflags apply with the ppc clang frontend: clang caches BusyBox's const global pointers across their initialization, and upstream's libbb.h prescribes -DBB_GLOBAL_CONST= for such toolchains.
